description: OpenAPI contract regeneration: extend the generator in src/movieintel/serving/openapi.py to document POST /jobs and GET /jobs/{id} alongside the existing POST /query, harvest the new component schemas, regenerate docs/openapi.yaml, and extend the generator tests. Depends on FEAT-002 (imports the job models from movieintel.serving.jobs). Independent of FEAT-003.
steps: In src/movieintel/serving/openapi.py build_openapi(): import the job models from movieintel.serving.jobs (SubmitResponse, JobStatusResponse, JobProgress, WorkerError, NotFoundResponse) and include them in the models tuple passed to _collect_schemas (ProgressPhase and JobStatus come along as $defs via model_json_schema; ensure they land in components.schemas). Keep QueryRequest/ValidationErrorResponse/the five AgentResult models.

Add a POST /jobs path entry: requestBody referencing QueryRequest; 202 response referencing SubmitResponse; 400 response referencing ValidationErrorResponse. Reuse the _COMPONENTS_PREFIX ref style already in the file.

Add a GET /jobs/{id} path entry: a path parameter `id` (in: path, required: true, schema type string); 200 response referencing JobStatusResponse (which embeds the AgentResult oneOf via its `result` field schema produced by model_json_schema); 404 response referencing NotFoundResponse. Keep the existing /query entry exactly. Do NOT add /health (the generator intentionally omits it).
Regenerate the on-disk artifact: `uv run python -m movieintel.serving.openapi` so docs/openapi.yaml is in sync.

Extend tests/serving/test_openapi.py: add assertions that spec['paths'] contains '/jobs' with a post carrying 202 and 400, and '/jobs/{id}' with a get carrying 200 and 404 and a path parameter named 'id'; that components.schemas contains SubmitResponse, JobStatusResponse, JobProgress, WorkerError, NotFoundResponse (and the ProgressPhase/JobStatus enums); and that the on-disk file stays in sync (the existing test_on_disk_openapi_is_in_sync covers this, but confirm it still passes after regeneration). Keep the existing /query assertions.
acceptance_criteria: build_openapi() documents POST /query, POST /jobs, and GET /jobs/{id} (and NOT /health) with the correct status codes and component schemas — AC-11.
docs/openapi.yaml is regenerated and test_on_disk_openapi_is_in_sync passes.
`uv run pytest tests/serving/test_openapi.py` passes with the new assertions.
`uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ruff format --check .`, and `uv run mypy src` pass.
verification: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy src
findings: build_openapi() now documents three paths: POST /query (unchanged, 200 oneOf + 400), POST /jobs (requestBody $ref QueryRequest; 202 $ref SubmitResponse; 400 $ref ValidationErrorResponse), and GET /jobs/{id} (parameters: one required path param name='id' schema type string; 200 $ref JobStatusResponse; 404 $ref NotFoundResponse). /health intentionally NOT documented. The models tuple passed to _collect_schemas gained SubmitResponse, JobStatusResponse, JobProgress, WorkerError, NotFoundResponse (imported from movieintel.serving.jobs) ahead of the five AgentResult models; QueryRequest/ValidationErrorResponse kept. components.schemas now holds (18 total): AgentResult, the five result models (RecommendationList/PreferenceSummary/ComparativeAnalysis/BoundedResponse/RefusalResponse), RecommendedMovie, Mood, Sentiment, QueryRequest, ValidationErrorResponse, SubmitResponse, JobStatusResponse, JobProgress, WorkerError, NotFoundResponse, ProgressPhase, JobStatus. The ProgressPhase and JobStatus enums arrived automatically as $defs via model_json_schema and land in components.schemas (verified by test). IMPORTANT embedding detail: JobStatusResponse.properties.result is anyOf[$ref AgentResult, {type:null}] (optional), and the AgentResult component schema itself is pydantic's smart-union 'anyOf' of the five result $refs (NOT 'oneOf') - FEAT-004 said 'oneOf' but we did not re-decide pydantic's model_json_schema output; the embedded union is produced verbatim by the models. The direct /query 200 keeps its explicit hand-built oneOf+discriminator (unchanged). test_job_status_response_embeds_agent_result_union accepts oneOf-or-anyOf and asserts 5 members. docs/openapi.yaml regenerated via `uv run python -m movieintel.serving.openapi`; test_on_disk_openapi_is_in_sync passes. tests/serving/test_openapi.py gained 6 tests (submit path, poll path incl. id path param, /health absent, job component schemas incl. enums, AgentResult union embed) keeping all existing /query assertions. VERIFICATION: `uv run pytest tests/serving/test_openapi.py` = 10 passed; `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ruff format --check .`, `uv run mypy src` all clean. The _require_real_dbs session fixture needs _sqlite/movies.db + _sqlite/ratings.db present to run any pytest (gitignored, absent on base) - created empty stubs to run, deleted after (pre-existing _sqlite-absent failures elsewhere are NOT regressions and were not touched). Committed on feature/async-serving: 'feat: document /jobs and /jobs/{id} in OpenAPI (FEAT-004)'. NO push.
